summary: The study evaluates the impact of physical and chemical defects in WO3 thin films on photoelectrochemical (PEC) water splitting performance. The results show that ALD-deposited WO3 films annealed in air have the least physical defects and an appropriate amount of oxygen vacancies, leading to the highest PEC performance.
evidence: The highest performance was obtained for WO3 films deposited by ALD and annealed in air, which have the least physical defects and an appropriate amount of oxygen vacancies.
